commit.message:
docs: comprehensive README refresh — verified feature coverage, Dependencies, API reference

This is a full regeneration of README.md, composed and verified directly against the current
source tree (pinned at 4a8d9cd1df3, the real HEAD at the time of this PR) rather than an
incremental edit — the previous README, while accurate, predates several now-shipped feature
areas and did not yet document them.

- Add a module-grouped API Reference table mirroring reference.aspose.org's own class index,
  collapsed behind a details block alongside curated per-class member documentation
- Add a Dependencies section (required/optional/native-system/development), sourced directly
  from go.mod
- Document document-level JavaScript actions (Add/Get/Has/Remove/Names/Count/Clear) and the
  OpenAction/SetOpenAction/RemoveOpenAction API
- Document RTL/Bidi/Arabic text-shaping support (TextStyle.RTL)
- Document Image-to-PDF and image replace/remove APIs (ImageToDocument, ImageInfo.Replace/
  Remove)
- Document "Linearizing for Fast Web View" (SaveLinearized/WriteToLinearized)
- Restructure Key Capabilities, Quick Start, Additional Examples, Scope and Limitations, and
  Development and Testing to the current documentation template, with every capability claim
  individually re-verified against the real source at the pinned commit

Verification: every claim in this README was checked against the real, current source (not
carried forward from the prior version on trust); the deterministic preservation/accuracy
check battery — content-unit disposition coverage and evidence resolution, API-reference-table
completeness, diagram verified-format-claims, dependency accuracy, Enterprise-Edition-link
resolution — reports 0 hard-gate findings for this candidate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
